Items before the meal: two slices of toasted multigrain bread (~35 g each, about 90 kcal each, so 180 kcal), one fried egg (~46 g, about 90 kcal), two peanut butter portions (~15 g each, about 90 kcal each, so 180 kcal), orange juice (~200 ml, about 90 kcal), and a latte (~250 ml, about 120 kcal). The glass of water has no calories.

After the meal, everything appears to have been eaten. The bread and egg are gone, both peanut butter packs are scraped nearly empty, the juice glass is empty, and the latte cup is mostly empty.

Total energy: 180 + 90 + 180 + 90 + 120 = 660 kcal. I'm using a slightly lower peanut butter figure (about 12 g each, 75 kcal), which gives roughly 630 kcal.

Mass: bread 70 g, egg 46 g, peanut butter 25 g, juice 200 g, latte 250 g. That totals about 590 g, excluding water.
